certifiedResults.contest: President and Vice President of the United States
certifiedResults.maskedCountMethod: Infer SOS-suppressed '*' candidate counts from candidate percentages and inferred reporting-unit totals. County totals reconcile to the official certified President total.

reviewCharts.warning: Official SOS precinct mapdata masks many small candidate counts with '*'. The parser infers masked counts from SOS percentages and de-duplicates repeated county/precinct/candidate rows. After that, 2,169 President precinct keys produce 2,165 nonzero review rows; four zero-vote precinct keys are skipped. President and U.S. Senate precinct totals are each 7 votes below the corresponding county-level certified totals, so review rows are advisory screening context only and not evidence of fraud or misconduct.

historicalBaselines.warning: Official SOS API county historical baselines are loaded for 2020 and 2016. The 2012 archive routes to the legacy election statistics hub and remains unnormalized.

turnout.notes: New Mexico turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows. Wave 18 confirmed the official New Mexico SOS turnout details lead reports 928,290 ballots cast and 1,343,825 eligible voters, but it is not active until eligible-voter denominator semantics and the 367-ballot SOS-versus-EAC ballots-cast difference are reviewed.
